Orbiting a desolate planet, this ancient habitat was built by the adAkkaria Convention. The high quality building materials used in its construction have ensured the station is in near pristine condition.

sections.en:
Orbiting a desolate planet, this ancient habitat was built by the adAkkaria Convention. The high quality building materials used in its construction have ensured the station is in near pristine condition.

Tuning into the transmission frequency, we picked up a single message, followed by a bombastic jingle: Welcome to the Patriotic Institute of Exalted Benevolence.

texts.zh:
在气闸的另一头是一座小小的隧道网。在尽头，我们找到了一条通往人造阳光照亮的巨大广场的路。奇怪的是，这个居住站的建筑更像某些居住星球上的郊区，而不是一个如此著名的科学站。这座居住站设计为能够容纳整座公寓大楼、购物中心和学校，并且还设有游乐园、公园等其他设施。这是一个为奢华生活而设计的地方。

然而，它现在完全被遗弃了。在整座居住站中没有发现半个有机生命形式。我们一边继续探索，一边被这个地方的空虚和荒凉的气氛所震撼。

人造阳光偶尔会出现故障，让空间站陷入暂时的黑暗，虽然其他电子设备大部分仍在运行，但它们也受到同样的干扰。最令人好奇的是在居住站的公寓内发现的监控设备网络。看来这里的每位公民都受到了严格的监督。寻找到一座安保站也许能提供更多线索。
texts.en:
Beyond the airlock stretched a small network of tunnels. At last we found our way to a massive plaza lit by artificial sunlight. Strangely, the architecture of the habitat was more akin to the suburbs found on certain residential worlds than of a prominent science station. The habitat was built to house entire apartment complexes, shopping centers and schools, but also pleasure gardens, parks and other facilities. This was a place designed for luxury living.

Now however it is entirely abandoned. Not a single organic lifeform was detected within the entirety of the habitat. And we continued to explore, we were struck by the emptiness of this place and the bleak staleness of the atmosphere.

The artificial sunlight experienced occasional glitches, covering the station in darkness, and while other electronic devices are remain largely operational, they too are affected by these same interruptions. But most curious is the network of surveillance devices found within the apartments of the habitat. It appears every citizen was under strict supervision. Finding a security station of some sort could provide more insight.

texts.zh:
我们花费了数天时间探索并且编目整座空间站上的城市，并发现了它的安保设备。事实证明，安保站与居住站的其他部分是完全隔离开来的，需要使用不同的入口密码。

我们在这里发现了一排排的监视器，背后连接着规模宏大的监控设备。那些仍能正常工作的设备向我们展示了空间站的每个角落，当然它们也会受到电力故障的影响。

我们的无人机汇报称，在目睹这种破败景象后，他们很担心，因为这让他们想起了此前在古代舰队坟场与阿达卡利亚公约的遭遇。

但最令人不安的是我们发现的中央安全中心：根据屏幕上显示的警报信息，这个居住站已经被设为自毁模式了！

我们的[Root.Owner.GetEngineerPlural]认为是城市出现了什么故障导致命令无法执行。我们迅速关闭了自毁程序，并让[Root.Owner.GetLinguists]来破译这里所有能恢复出来的日志。奇怪的是，在从宣传站那找到最后的记录的几乎一年之前，这座居住站的报告就停止了。
texts.en:
It took many days to traverse and index the city aboard the station and to uncover its surveillance apparatus. The security station turned out to be entirely sectioned off from the rest of the habitat, requiring a different entrance code all together.

Here we found rows and rows of monitors, still hooked up to the mass surveillance apparatus. Those still functional showed us every corner of the station, yet they too were affected by electric glitches.

Our drones reported being concerned upon witnessing the disruptions, as it reminded them of the previous encounter with the adAkkaria Convention at the ancient naval graveyard.

But most disturbing was our discovery of the central security hub: according to the alarming messages displayed on the screens, this habitat was set to self-destruct!

Our [Root.Owner.GetEngineerPlural] assumed that whatever malfunctions were plaguing the city prevented the command from being executed. We swiftly deactivated the self-destruct routine and set our [Root.Owner.GetLinguists] to decipher any logs we could recover here. Curiously, the station's reports ceased almost a year before the last records recovered from the Propaganda Station.

texts.zh:
我们的[Root.Owner.GetLinguists]很快就发现了围绕[From.Planet.GetName]的这座居住站的作用：来自公民和工作人员的日志以及信息都描述了对阿达卡利亚公民中新出现的灵能者的调查。所有住在这里的人都受到最高领袖的邀请，在这里享受奢华的生活和自我表达。作为回报，他们同意参加空间站正在进行的实验。

大多数公民都热衷于加入这项计划。安全日志显示，其中许多是残疾的退伍军人。他们得到了照顾、经济援助和赦免他们可能遇到的任何悬而未决的法律问题的承诺。

更重要的是，居住站的人员名单上有一个非常熟悉的名字：阿拉塔·蓝迪尔他是一名科学家兼残疾老兵，此前他被截肢的尸体被我们在舰队坟场发现。
texts.en:
Our [Root.Owner.GetLinguists] didn't take long to discover the purpose of the habitat orbiting [From.Planet.GetName]: logs and messages from citizens and staff alike describe investigations into the newly emerged psionic powers of the adAkkaria citizens. All those living here received invitations from the Convention's 'Exalted Leadership' to enjoy a life of luxury and self-expression aboard the habitat. In return, they agreed to participate in the station's ongoing experiments.

Most citizens were keen to join the program. The security logs show many were disabled war veterans. They were promised care, financial assistance, and pardons for any outstanding legal issues they might have had.

What's more, the station's personnel list contained a very familiar name: alAtta Landeer, a scientist and disabled veteran, whose amputated body we recovered at the naval graveyard.

texts.zh:
我们破译出了从居住站发出的最后一条信息：

信息——日期02100363——发件人：西达尼·伊腾皮尔——收件人：西祖尔·伊腾皮尔
嗨！我还活着！很抱歉回晚了。自从……以来居住站就变得很奇怪，所以发送信息就很困难。他们说这与此无关，但我们认为他毕竟有灵能天赋。至于我嘛，我也跟你你说过了，我没什么进展啦，毕竟之前发生了那么多……所以他们也建议尝试一些更激进的方法：……宇宙风暴。我知道你在想什么，但不过就是根指头罢了，兴许还会再长回来呢。但当……我释放的感觉……！
爱你的，西达尼
——通讯已审核（有问题？询问导师）

信息——日期02100365——发件人：哈图尔·盖隆——收件人：艾达尔·阿斯杜尔
亲爱的艾达尔，
我在这一直过得很好。我还见了其他的一些老兵。我们没有说什么话但互相都理解了，不用说话真好。
今天我只是想着要举起杯子，它就飘起来了。我仍然想念我的右附肢，但也许这种新生活也不像我担心的那么糟糕。我听说他们要把我送到……显然我是个灵能神童……我……想再次被部署了。
我希望能回家过爱国者节。到时候再见吧。
此致。哈图尔。
——通讯已审核（有问题？询问导师）

信息——日期02100367——发件人：恩瑞达·迪伦——收件人：翁瑞达·迪伦
我用意念熄灭了火焰！！！
有一个实验对象不知道怎么突然歇斯底里了起来，在食堂里引起了火灾。大家都很恐慌，而且无路可逃！我也超级害怕，但后来不知道体内发生了什么，我就把火扑灭了！
我救了大家！！告诉长老们我并不是无可救药的失败品，快帮帮忙！
——通讯已屏蔽（立刻向导师汇报）

值得注意的是第二个通讯：哈图尔·盖隆的就是我们之前在[Root.Owner.GetPreFTLLowerPlural]星球上的考古任务中发现的那具尸体。
texts.en:
We have deciphered one of the last messages sent from the habitat:

Message - Date 02100363 - Sender: siDani Itempeer - Recipient: siZul Itempeer
Hi! I'm still alive! Sorry for the delays. Ever since... the habitat is behaving strangely so sending messages has been hard. They say it has nothing to do with that, but we think he was psionically gifted after all. As for me, I told you I wasn't really getting anywhere, with all the previous... So they suggested trying out something more radical: ... cosmic storms. I know what you're thinking, but it's just one digit and maybe it'll even grow back. But the sensations I've unlocked when... !
Love, siDani
- TRANSMISSION CENSORED ( Questions? Ask your supervisor )

Message - Date 02100365 - Sender: haToor Gailon - Recipient: aeDal Asduur
Dear aeDal,
Life has been treating me well. I've met a few other veterans. We don't talk. But we all know. It's nice not having to talk.
Today I only had to think of lifting a cup, and it did. I still miss my right appendage, but maybe this new life won't be as bad as I feared. I've heard them talk about sending me to... Apparently I'm a psionic prodigy... I... want to be deployed again.
I hope to be home for Patriots' Day. Let's meet up.
Yours, haToor
- TRANSMISSION CENSORED ( Questions? Ask your supervisor )

Message - Date 02100367 - Sender: enRida Direen - Recipient: onRida Direen
I STOPPED A FIRE WITH MY MIND!!!!
One of the other subjects went all hysterical for some reason and caused a fire to break out in the mess hall. Everyone was just panicking but we couldn't go anywhere! I was also SUPER scared but then something happened inside me and I just made it go away!
I SAVED EVERYONE!! Tell the elders I'm not entirely a hopeless case, will you!
- TRANSMISSION BLOCKED ( REPORT TO YOUR SUPERVISOR IMMEDIATELY )

Notable is the second transmission: haToor Gailon's body was discovered during our archeological mission on the [Root.Owner.GetPreFTLLowerPlural] world.

texts.zh:
这些信息的日期是居住站撤离前的几天：

信息——日期02100359——发件人：至高博士——收件人：崇敬舰队司令
你的上一条信息在这里引起了一些关切。你能解释一下为什么这么多年来一直默默支持我们，现在却突然威胁要关闭这里吗？
——通讯已发送

信息——日期02100360——发件人：崇敬舰队司令——收件人：至高博士
你在跟我开玩笑吧。几个月以来我的都一直在给你警告，但我猜是不是绕着一颗反复无常的星球转给你造成了某种方便的健忘症。你知道宇联正在威胁我们的生存，对吧？战争愈演愈烈，我没办法为挥霍大笔资源就为了让你的实验对象能整天盯着牲畜看这种事情辩护了。我需要切实可行的结果，现在立刻。
——通讯已收到

信息——日期02100360——发件人：至高博士——收件人：崇敬舰队司令
请原谅，我们没有收到你之前的信息。我们的电台一直受到技术故障的困扰，这肯定也影响了我们的通讯。不管怎样，我们需要更多的时间。我们有适当的程序和协议，不能就这样半途而废！
——通讯已发送

信息——日期02100361——发件人：崇敬舰队司令——收件人：至高博士
给你一周时间，不然我就要立刻关停了。没有什么如果，没有什么但是，也没有第二次机会，我要结果！
——通讯已收到

信息——日期02100368——发件人：至高博士——收件人：崇敬舰队司令
随信附上一份我们最近取得的进度报告。这些视频证明了我们这些有灵能天赋的人可以影响宇宙风暴。这可能有惊人的军事应用。如果有足够的时间，我们可以增强他们的灵能表达而不必造成身心创伤。
——通讯失败（原因：通讯矩阵崩溃）
texts.en:
These messages are dated a few days before the evacuation of the habitat:

Message - Date 02100359 - Sender: Supreme Doctor - Recipient: Revered Admiral
Your last message caused some concern here. Would you be so kind as to explain why after supporting us for all these years without a comment, you're suddenly threatening to shut us down?
- TRANSMISSION SENT

Message - Date 02100360 - Sender: Revered Admiral - Recipient: Supreme Doctor
You have got to be kidding me. For months we've been sending you warnings, but I guess orbiting a capricious world must have caused some convenient amnesia. You are aware that Unicom is threatening our very existence, correct? And with this war ramping up, I can no longer defend spending exorbitant resources just for your subjects to stare at cattle all day. I need tangible, applicable results. NOW.
- TRANSMISSION RECEIVED

Message - Date 02100360 - Sender: Supreme Doctor - Recipient: Revered Admiral
Forgive us, we never received your earlier messages. Our station has been plagued by technical glitches, and it must've affected our transmissions as well. Regardless, we need more time. We have processes and protocols in place, we can't just abandon them!
- TRANSMISSION SENT

Message - Date 02100361 - Sender: Revered Admiral - Recipient: Supreme Doctor
You have one week or else we will proceed to immediate shutdown. No ifs, no buts, no second chances, RESULTS!
- TRANSMISSION RECEIVED

Message - Date 02100368 - Sender: Supreme Doctor - Recipient: Revered Admiral
Attached you'll find a report of our recent accomplishments. These videos prove that cosmic storms can be influenced by our psionically gifted subjects. This could have staggering military applications. Given enough time we can supercharge their psionic expression without having to subject them to physical and mental trauma.
- TRANSMISSION FAILED (Cause: Transmission Matrix Corruption)

label.zh: 最后一条信息没发出去。
label.en: That last message was never sent.

texts.zh:
这是恢复出来的最后一条信息：

亲爱的同事们，

我以沉重的心情告知你们，崇高指挥部决定停止崇高仁善爱国协会的一切活动。

这不是对你们大家工作的控诉。能与你们大家一起工作是我的荣幸。我知道你们会有很多疑问，但简而言之，崇高仁善的期望与我们的研究目标并不一致。

至于我们的公民，崇高司令部邀请他们到艾德苏尔的爱国庆典学院参与项目。您可以在下面找到完整的人员名单。

至于其他人……很遗憾，我们研究的保密性意味着研究参与者将不被允许回归社会。崇敬指挥部答应派一支特别单位负责处理他们。你们不需要亲自见证，这本身也是一种祝福。他们的亲属将得到最大限度的补偿。

此致。
至高博士，阿拉塔·蓝迪尔

所附的列表，虽然部分损坏，但提到了哈图尔·盖隆和恩瑞达·迪伦。他们似乎被转移到了阿达卡利亚公约的首都艾德苏尔。我们现在已经得到了这颗星球的坐标。
texts.en:
This is the last recovered message:

Dear colleagues,

I address you with a heavy heart. Exalted Command has decided to cease all operations inside the Patriotic Institute of Exalted Benevolence.

This should not be taken as an indictment of you or our work here. It has been an honor to serve with each and every one of you. I know that you will have many questions, but in short, the expectations of Exalted Command did not align with our research aims.

As for our citizens, Exalted Command invited them to join the program at the Patriotic Institute of Celebration on adSul. You will find a full personnel list attached below. Please inform your reports accordingly.

As for the others... Regrettably, the covert nature of our research means that research participants will not be allowed to return to society proper. Exalted Command promised to send us a special unit to take care of them. You will not need to see to this yourselves, which in its own way is a blessing. Their relatives will be compensated to the fullest.

Signing off, 
Supreme Doctor, alAtta Landeer

The attached list, while partially corrupted, mentions the subjects haToor Gailon and enRida Direen. It appears they were transferred to the adAkkaria Convention's capital of adSul. The coordinates to this world are now in our possession.

label.zh: 设定前往公约母星的航线。
label.en: Set course to the Convention's homeworld.

texts.zh:
这组坐标揭示了一个之前对我们扫描隐藏的星系。是时候去拜访一下阿达卡利亚公约了，趁其他人还没这么做之前。

发起了一项新的特殊项目。
texts.en:
The coordinates revealed a system previously hidden from our scanners. The time has come to pay the adAkkaria Convention a visit - before anyone else does.

A new special project has been issued.

texts.zh:
就在离开居住站后不久，[event_target:leader_patriotic_institute.GetName]做出了一个唐突而令人震惊的决定。就像被某种外力驱使一般，[event_target:leader_patriotic_institute.GetHeShe]命令舰船打开了一个通常与大规模灵能事件或转瞬即逝的宇宙风暴有关的通讯频道。

该频道指向与阿达卡利亚公约母星系相同的坐标。只过了一小会儿我们的呼叫就得到了回应。
texts.en:
Only moments after leaving the habitat, [event_target:leader_patriotic_institute.GetName] made an abrupt and stunning decision. As if driven by an outside force, [event_target:leader_patriotic_institute.GetHeShe] ordered the ship to open a communication channel on a frequency typically associated with mass psionic events or the passage of an evanescent cosmic storm.

The channel was directed at the same coordinates as dAkkaria Convention's home system. It took only an instant for our hails to be returned.

texts.zh:
离开居住站后不久，我们的集体仪式被一种不寻常的振动所干扰，仿佛有什么东西试图在遥远的地方与我们交流。这个信号来自与阿达卡利亚公约的母星系相同的坐标，并且发生在于一个典型的与大规模灵能事件或转瞬即逝的宇宙风暴通过有关的频率上。

我们的回电立即得到了回应。
texts.en:
Moments after leaving the habitat, our group consciousness was troubled by an unusual vibration, as if something was trying to communicate with us over a vast distance. The signal originated from the same coordinates as the adAkkaria Convention's home system, and existed on a frequency typically associated with mass psionic events or the passage of an evanescent cosmic storm.

Our return hail was instantly answered.

texts.zh:
尽管我们尝试过所有的方案，但到达艾德苏尔的挑战还是比预想的要大得多。整个恒星系被未知成分的宇宙风暴吞没，使我们无法靠近这颗行星。

至于这场吞没星系的风暴，它似乎是在……向我们打招呼？
texts.en:
We did everything possible, but getting to adSul proved to be a much bigger challenge than anticipated. The entire system is engulfed by a cosmic storm of unknown composition, making it impossible for us to get any closer to the planet.

As for the storm, it appears to be... hailing us?
